candidate_laws: FIELD SCHEMA SHOULD GENERATE EXPOSURE + EVALUATION + TRACE

components.historical_mechanism: nodes + edges + clusters/topology addresses; explicit relation-bearing structure
components.reason: CFE needs a curator-side representation of field topology, but it must remain distinct from learner ontology.

components.historical_mechanism: edge type/weight plus later derivation graph and directional trust-chain concepts
components.reason: Replace generic semantic edges with explicit causal, temporal, attribution, consequence, contradiction, recurrence, support, anti-isomorph and provenance edge types.

components.historical_mechanism: node salience, novelty relative to history, activation state and spreading activation
components.reason: Potential field-pressure and retrieval diagnostics; must not be treated as learner internal state without evidence.

components.historical_mechanism: radial relevance distance; hot local and cold long-range edges
components.reason: Local vs long-range relational structure is useful; radial layout and hardware cache mapping are implementation choices, not ontology.

components.historical_mechanism: novelty computed against persistent CIL historical centroids
components.reason: CFE requires history-sensitive field state, but centroid distance is only one crude estimator.

components.historical_mechanism: pattern genome generates gates, transformations and evidence; starmap and enforcer are two projections of one source
components.reason: One authoritative field specification should generate exposure schedule, evaluation slices, audits and trace surfaces to prevent schema/compiler drift.

components.historical_mechanism: multi-hop fact propagation / spreading activation with convergence budget
components.reason: Useful for analyzing relational reach and consequence chains; not evidence of learner cognition.

components.historical_mechanism: PCA/embed projection to 3D then Hilbert mapping for locality/cache layout
components.reason: Physical locality can improve implementation efficiency but PHYSICAL LOCALITY != DEVELOPMENTAL LOCALITY.

components.historical_mechanism: cosine/L2 proximity used to define edges, coherence and clusters
components.reason: Semantic embedding proximity cannot stand in for causal/temporal/attribution relation identity; CURATOR EMBEDDING GEOMETRY != LEARNER FIELD GEOMETRY.

components.historical_mechanism: k-means clusters treated as coherent concept neighborhoods
components.reason: v1.0-v1.3 show coherent proximity does not imply identifying or useful developmental pressure.

components.historical_mechanism: low/high entropy triggers physical topology re-sort
components.reason: Could inspire drift monitors, but entropy thresholds and physical reordering are not an earned cognitive homeostasis law.

components.historical_mechanism: constellation/slot identity plus immutable ledger / derivation provenance
components.reason: Stable node/edge identity and derivation lineage are directly useful for reproducible field compilation and causal audit.

hard_prohibitions: Do not expose curator edge labels to learner unless experiment explicitly tests that exposure.
Do not use embedding distance as causal/temporal/attribution truth.
Do not import Hilbert/PCA topology as a cognitive law.
Do not let StarMap terminology override CFE evidence or Commander intent.
